verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen stack passive and trade into full Courage; you win if you force fights with E up and punish his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: This is a near-50/50 lane (49.8% over 203 games) decided by who controls when damage lands. Garen's Passive (Perseverance) heals him back to full if he avoids damage for a few seconds, so your entire job is denying that window; your E (Sky Splitter) and W (Frenzied Maul) both apply direct, repeatable damage that keeps his regen off.

theirWindow.when: Q (Decisive Strike) silence lands on you
theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike breaks his slows and silences on the next hit — if he lands it mid-trade you can't use W or R to extend, so disengage with Q (Thundering Smash) stun or back off until it's down.

yourWindow.when: his E (Judgment) and Q are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Trade with W into W for the mark-and-heal proc, or land E (Sky Splitter) to slow and shield before fighting — this is when he has no escape and no silence to punish your commitment.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: most-picked start (71.7% of games) and gives sustain plus early ability haste to keep W and E cycling through poke exchanges

boots.why: highest win rate boots (50.4% over 127 games) — Garen's W and auto-resets are physical, so the reduced auto damage directly blunts his trade pattern

core.why: most common first core item, builds into ability haste for faster W/E cycles
core second item in the top build path, pushes W procs and attack speed from passive stacking
highest win-rate completed path (43.8%), magic resist plus healing amp stacks with W's self-heal to out-sustain his Perseverance

runes.keystoneWhy: attack speed ramp rewards sticking on him through his Q silence window and punishes him every time Perseverance tries to kick in

summoners.why: most-picked combo (73% pick rate) and Ignite directly cancels his Perseverance passive regen during all-in windows

playing.title: Deny his passive heal
playing.detail: Garen's Perseverance heals him back if he takes no damage for a few seconds. Poke with W every time it's off cooldown (5s) so he never gets a clean window.

playing.title: Track Decisive Strike cooldown
playing.detail: His Q (8s cooldown) breaks slows and silences your next ability on hit. Don't commit W-W or R into a fresh Q — bait it out first with a short trade.

playing.title: E before you all-in
playing.detail: Sky Splitter slows and shields you if you're in the blast. Land it before fully committing so he can't Q away and you have the shield for his Judgment spin.

playing.title: Save Q stun for his E window
playing.detail: Thundering Smash stuns on your first attack after the dash. Use it to lock him in place right as Judgment goes on cooldown so he can't disengage or reset trades.

playing.title: Avoid long trades under his W
playing.detail: Courage reduces incoming damage for its duration on a 20-24s cooldown. Don't commit your full W-W combo while it's active — wait it out or bait it early.

playing.title: Ult to deny his execute
playing.detail: His R (Demacian Justice) scales down to a 20s cooldown at rank 3 and executes low-health targets. Once you're both near ult, don't sit at low HP without Stormbringer's bonus health or an escape ready.

playing.title: Push for plates, not kills
playing.detail: This lane is even in win rate but Volibear holds the solo-kill edge — play for sustained pressure and tower plates rather than forcing all-ins before level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-timing and cooldown-punish reasoning is my own tactical read layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] often to prevent Garen’s (P) from activating. Use Grasp of the Undying whenever it comes off cooldown to engage combat.
